literal: To do difficult things those who do are great; small ones are those who to do difficult things cannot do.
translation: The great are those who accomplish things that are difficult to do. The small are those who cannot achieve such difficult things.
modern: செய்வதற்கு கடினமான செயல்களைச் செய்து முடிப்பவர்களே பெரியோர்கள். அத்தகைய கடினமான செயல்களைச் செய்ய முடியாதவர்கள் சிறியோர்கள் ஆவர்.
explanation: This couplet defines greatness and smallness based on a person's capacity for action. The word 'periyar' (great ones) refers to those who have the discipline and resolve to accomplish tasks that are exceptionally difficult. In the context of this chapter, this points to the immense difficulty of renouncing worldly attachments and controlling the senses. Conversely, 'ciṟiyar' (small ones) are those who lack this inner strength and fail to perform such challenging deeds.
